title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Venice 2026 #1: Twinning
excerpt_original: Critics Miriam Bale and Öykü Sofuoğlu discuss new films from Werner Herzog, Martin McDonagh, Paul Schrader, and more

blocks.text: This week and next, Film Comment is reporting from the picturesque shores of the Lido, where the Venice Film Festival takes place each year. This year’s edition features new films by many major auteurs, including Werner Herzog, Lee Chang-dong, Tsai Ming-liang, and more.

To kick off our coverage, Film Comment Co-Editor Devika Girish invited critics Miriam Bale and Öykü Sofuoğlu to discuss some of the most highly anticipated premieres of the festival’s first days, including Martin McDonagh’s Wild Horse Nine (2:45), Werner Herzog’s Bucking Fastard (10:10), Paul Schrader’s The Basics of Philosophy (22:06), and Lance Oppenheim’s Primetime (31:52).
Subscribe today to Film Comment to stay up-to-date with all of our Venice 2026 coverage.
